room_rent.note: For SI ≥10L: 2% of SI/day or Single Standard AC Room, whichever less. For SI <10L: 1.5% (Class A cities) or 1.25% (other cities) of SI/day. ICU: 3% of SI/day (SI ≥10L); 2.5%/2% for <10L.

icu.note: For SI ≥10L: 3% of SI/day or actuals whichever less. For SI <10L: 2.5% (Class A) or 2% (other cities) of SI/day.

copayment.note: No mandatory co-pay. Voluntary co-pay of 10%, 20% or 25% can be opted at inception for premium discount; once opted cannot be removed during policy period.

sub_limits.display: Cataract, ENT, Hernia, Hysterectomy, Piles, Knee Ligament, Joint Replacement, PIVD capped
sub_limits.note: Cataract: ₹50k–₹1L/eye by SI slab; ENT disorders: 10% of SI up to ₹1.5L; Hernia: 10% SI up to ₹1.5L/site; Hysterectomy: 10% SI up to ₹2L; Piles/Fissure/Fistula: 10% SI up to ₹1.5L; Knee Ligament: 10% SI up to ₹2L; Joint Replacement: 20% SI up to ₹3L/replacement; PIVD/spinal: 20% SI up to ₹3L. Modern treatments capped at 50% of SI.

deductible.note: No aggregate deductible mentioned in the base policy.

initial_waiting.note: First 30 days waiting period for illnesses; accidents exempt.

ped_waiting.note: PED waiting period is 36 months of continuous coverage. Reduced by prior continuous coverage under portability/migration.

specific_disease_waiting.note: 12-month list: tonsillitis, tympanoplasty, piles/fistula, carcinoma, varicose veins, ligament tears. 24-month list: cataract, hernia, hydrocele, hysterectomy, uterine fibroids, sinusitis, gallstones, PIVD, knee/joint replacement, chronic renal failure, benign growths.

maternity.note: Maternity expenses explicitly excluded under Standard Exclusion Excl18. Ectopic pregnancy is covered.

cumulative_bonus.display: Up to 100% of basic SI (25% yr1, 10%/yr after)
cumulative_bonus.note: 25% of basic SI after first claim-free year, then 10% per subsequent claim-free year, max 100% of basic SI. Reduces at accrual rate on claim. Alternatively, insured may opt for 5% No Claim Discount on premium instead.

restoration.note: 100% of basic SI reinstated once per policy year after exhaustion. Not available for relapses within 45 days, domiciliary/home care, or for listed chronic/critical illnesses (cancer, CABG, stroke, etc.) if initial claim was for same condition.

pre_hosp.note: Pre-hospitalisation expenses covered for 60 days prior to hospitalisation for the same condition.

post_hosp.note: Post-hospitalisation expenses covered for 90 days after discharge for the same condition.

day_care.note: Extensive list of 380 day-care procedures in Annexure C covered. Also covers hospitalisation >12 hrs but <24 hrs at insurer's discretion with prior authorisation.

domiciliary.note: Domiciliary hospitalisation covered up to SI. Excluded for 16 specific conditions including asthma, diabetes, hypertension, epilepsy, arthritis, critical illnesses etc.

ayush.note: AYUSH hospitalisation in recognised AYUSH hospitals/day care centres covered including pre- and post-hospitalisation expenses.

organ_donor.note: Donor hospitalisation expenses covered subject to same sub-limits as insured patient. Donor room rent limited to 50% of insured's room rent limit. Ambulance, pre/post-hosp and daily allowance not payable for donor.

ambulance.note: Road ambulance charges payable only when hospitalisation claim is admissible. Not payable for organ donor.

modern_treatments.note: 12 modern treatment procedures covered (robotic surgery, HIFU, deep brain stimulation, oral chemo, immunotherapy, intravitreal injections, stereotactic radiosurgery, etc.) up to 50% of sum insured.

consumables.note: Consumable cover available as a paid extension. Once opted, cannot be removed at renewal. Covers selected items from the standard non-payable list (gloves, crepe bandage, diaper, slings, etc.).

global_cover.note: Territorial limit clause restricts all treatment to India only; claims payable in Indian currency only.

moratorium.note: After 60 continuous months of coverage (including portability/migration), no claim or policy contestable except on grounds of established fraud.

grace_period.note: 30 days grace for renewal and non-monthly instalment modes. 15 days for monthly instalment. Coverage available during grace period only for instalment-paid policies.

free_look.note: 30-day free-look period from receipt of policy document at inception only; not applicable on renewals or portability/migration.

portability.note: Portability to same product with other insurers allowed with continuity of waiting periods, CB and moratorium credits.

notable_exclusions: Maternity, sterility/IVF, OPD-only procedures converted to IP, intra-articular injections, adventure sports (professional & non-professional), external congenital anomalies, dental (unless hospitalised), 16 diseases excluded under domiciliary
optional_riders: Consumable cover (paid extension); Voluntary co-pay (10%/20%/25%) for premium discount; No Claim Discount (5% on base premium) as alternative to Cumulative Bonus
